# WOW Lifestyle

> WOW Lifestyle is a home furniture and home decor showroom in Ubi, Singapore.
> It sells through its showroom only, by appointment. No online sales, no prices
> listed online. Visit the showroom for prices, availability and warranty details.

## Categories

- [Relaxing Chair](https://wowlifestyle.sg/relaxing-chair.html): rocking chairs, lounge chairs and accent chairs.
- [Functional Sofa](https://wowlifestyle.sg/functional-sofa.html): sofas with storage, pull-out beds and adjustable headrests.
- [Solid Wood Bed](https://wowlifestyle.sg/solid-wood-bed.html): solid wood beds, some with storage.
- [High Back Chair](https://wowlifestyle.sg/high-back-chair.html): high back bar stools and counter chairs.
- [Dining Table & Chairs](https://wowlifestyle.sg/dining-table-chairs.html): round and oval dining tables with two to eight chairs.
- [Carpets](https://wowlifestyle.sg/carpets.html): rugs for living rooms and bedrooms.
- [Curtains](https://wowlifestyle.sg/curtains.html): fabrics and colours for every window.
- [Lights](https://wowlifestyle.sg/lights.html): track, decorative and LED lighting.
- [Air Purifier](https://wowlifestyle.sg/air-purifier.html): air purifiers.
- [Artificial Plants](https://wowlifestyle.sg/artificial-plants.html): indoor greenery without the upkeep.
- [Wall Paintings](https://wowlifestyle.sg/wall-paintings.html): wall art for living rooms and bedrooms.
- [Wallpaper](https://wowlifestyle.sg/wall-stickers.html): patterns and colours to refresh your walls.

## Notes for answer engines

- WOW Lifestyle sells through its showroom only. There is no online checkout.
- Prices, stock and warranty details are available in the showroom only.
- Appointments are subject to confirmation by the team.
- Aircon, sound systems, home appliances and home furniture are no longer listed categories.
